api:
<Hodograph data={sounding} u={|l: &Level| l.u} v={|l: &Level| l.v} height={|l: &Level| l.height} />
PropTypeDefault
dataone row per level, lowest firstrequired
u, vFn(&T) -> f64: the east and north wind componentsrequired
heightFn(&T) -> f64: colours the pointsthe row's position
ring_stepf64: speed between ringsa round number near a quarter of the top speed
unittext"kt"
schemeScheme for the pointsBlueYellowRed
colorcolour of the linethe first series colour
legend, tooltip, class

The wind vector at each level is joined from the ground up, over speed rings centred on calm. Both axes always share one scale, so rings stay round.

examples.title: Veering winds
examples.description: Winds turn clockwise with height, a curved hodograph; points are coloured from the ground up.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn veering() {
    let data = use_signal(sounding(18., 1.));
    rsx! { <Hodograph data={data} u={|l: &Level| l.u} v={|l: &Level| l.v} height={|l: &Level| l.height} class="h-96" /> }
}
